shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- package.json ---' && cat package.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- next.config.ts ---' && cat next.config.ts && for f in app/*.tsx; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$f"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && printf '\\n--- diff ---\\n' && git diff -- app/page.tsx tsconfig.json package.json && printf '\\n--- page with lines ---\\n' && nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,220p'"
